_comment: Single source for the resource-page CTA copy. Read by src/components/ResourceCTA.tsx (SPA) and scripts/prerender.mjs (crawler HTML) so the two renders never drift. Keys in byCategory override default per siteContent.resourcePages[].category. Editorial rules: the free tier is email-verified (never say 'no signup'); no SolCrys self-numbers. The 'project' block replaces the default on pages that set cta: 'project' (SolCrys Sites, SolCrys Motion): the action is a project inquiry, not the free workspace.
